rules: This file freezes code identity only; it does not authorize any value read.
Before a future value-stage run, current Git blob identity for each script must equal the frozen value here or a new prospective code-freeze review is required.
Any code edit after this freeze invalidates the old code identity for value-stage authority.
G4/G5 PASS_TD_RELATIONAL_PREFLIGHT_DRIVER_VALUE_BLIND remains required before any value-stage authority can be used.
A separate owner value-read authorization remains required even when code identity matches.
Training, EMA, TD60, target selection, TEST, DEV/SEALED, pathology, Morabito and external biology remain unauthorized.
